name: Horizon no Ue ~Yogen no Sho~
original_name: ホリゾーンの上～預言の書～
source:
This happened a long, long time ago.
There was a world covered in thick dark clouds.
But people from far-away lands came.
They were treated like gods, and rid the world of the dark clouds.
The ground overflowed with light, and new life sprouted.

Trees. Animals. Fish. Birds.
The gods had changed it all.
But there were people who instead embraced the darkness.
They were sent down, to the centre of the world, to a place called "Est".
The rest united for a place called "Kaerum".
Over time, the two words grew apart and a name was given to the boundary line...

"Horizon..."
translation:
那是很久、很久以前發生的事。
有一個世界被厚重的烏雲覆蓋。
然而，來自遙遠大地的人們到來了。
他們被奉若神明，驅散了世間的烏雲。
大地灑滿光芒，新的生命開始萌發。

樹木、動物、魚類、鳥兒。
神明改變了一切。
但也有人反而選擇擁抱黑暗。
他們被送往世界中心，一個名為「埃斯特」的地方。
其餘人則為了名為「凱魯姆」的地方團結起來。
隨著時間流逝，兩個世界漸行漸遠，那條邊界也獲得了一個名字……

「地平線……」
